statement: Legacy PR #233 records a lexical-range caution that nissaya/nissāya can mean support or reliance and is not intrinsically identical with attachment; the exact relation among nissaya, anissita/anissaya, upādāna, nivesana, and samuggahīta remains open for dedicated lexical review.

provenance.note: Preserved as bounded lexical-range evidence; not a completed concordance.
